rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0001
rows.name:
Furia-chan's loads better now. It's
hard to believe that she's been ill
up until just the other day!

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0002
rows.name:
Anyway, we promised we'd all
go to the city together.

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0003
rows.name:
Furia-chan said she'd like
to try looking after the
Armus sometime too.

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0004
rows.name:
I'd always welcome that, but everyone
is practically competing over
Furia-chan.

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0005
rows.name: This is crazy. It's so much fun.

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0006
rows.name:
We're mucking about and having a laugh
the whole time. It's brilliant!

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0007
rows.name:
When I go to bed, I'm always thinking,
I can't wait for tomorrow! I never
felt so good about things before...

rows.label: tlk70000006_06_msg0008
rows.name:
We're so busy having fun, we
don't have time to get bored!
